The Ba2K3Ti6O16 structure (reduced formula BaK3Ti6O16) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 27 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ti centers coordinated by six O neighbors, alongside octahedral K centers coordinated by six O neighbors; Ba centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ti and K octahedra and face-sharing between Ba 12-vertex coordination polyhedra and Ti octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 27 sites.
